name: Spicy Cajun Shrimp Skillet with Zucchini, Corn & Bell Peppers

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 sticks celery
3 medium zucchini squash
3 red bell peppers

instructions.primary_message: In a large bowl, combine and mix together the spices.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp paprika
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp onion powder
⅜ tsp oregano
⅜ tsp cayenne pepper
⅜ tsp thyme
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Small dice the celery. Peel and mince the shallots.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat. Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the shallots and celery to the pot and cook, stirring occasionally, for 2-3 minutes.
Add the tomato paste and half of the spice mixture to the pot. Cook, stirring continuously, 1 minute.

Add the rice and broth to the pot and bring to a boil. Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the pot, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups basmati rice
1065 ml chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: 1.02 kg raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Add the shrimp and oil to the large bowl with the rest of the spice mixture. Stir to combine and set aside.
Halve zucchinis lengthwise, then slice crosswise into half moons. Medium dice the bell peppers.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat. Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the zucchini, bell pepper, and frozen corn to the skillet and cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 5-7 minutes. Cook in batches if necessary.
Add the shrimp to the skillet; cook until opaque, 2-3 minutes per side. Once done, remove skillet from heat.
To serve, divide the rice between bowls and top with the shrimp and vegetables. Enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen
